raw_text: India's navy has tracked a Chinese nuclear-powered submarine in the Bay of Bengal for three days, sources familiar with the operation told Asia Times. The submarine is believed to be a Type 093A Shang-class attack submarine. Indian Navy P-8I Poseidon aircraft and the corvette INS Kadmatt maintained persistent contact. The incident highlights growing Chinese subsurface presence in the Indian Ocean and India's determination to assert domain awareness in its near waters.
